The Jev core keeps its architecture and contracts unchanged. It changes
only to fix a defect, or to replace its run log with the sc-observability
logger (REQ-JEV-0008).

which_part.instructions: The failed gate and its answer are in state.gate. Which phrase of the item accounts for that answer or uncertainty? Use the whole record as context. Choose none if no listed part accounts for it; do not invent an explanation.

criteria.judge-jev tests: The phrase `judge-jev tests` accounts for the answer or uncertainty.
criteria.NOT depend: The phrase `NOT depend` accounts for the answer or uncertainty.
criteria.ordering: The phrase `ordering` accounts for the answer or uncertainty.
criteria.none: No listed part accounts for the answer or uncertainty.

argv:
scripts=$1
job=$2
first_model=$3
second_model=$4
bar=$5
decidr send --project decidr-question-tree --model "$first_model" --agent-role skill-author < "$job/request.json" \
  | tee "$job/gates.jsonl" \
  | jq -c --slurpfile item "$job/item.json" --slurpfile terms "$job/terms.json" --slurpfile tree "$job/tree.json" --argjson bar "$bar" -f "$scripts/next.jq" \
  | tee "$job/next.jsonl" \
  | bash "$scripts/send-next.sh" "$second_model" --project decidr-question-tree --agent-role skill-author \
  | tee "$job/stage2.jsonl" \
  | jq -c -f "$scripts/verdict.jq" > "$job/verdict.jsonl"
